fixtures.env: Duo E0 Hyacine (sustain, traces on: hpPct+10%/spdFlat+14/effRes+18, energyStartFrac 1 so the first action is the full-energy Ultimate 'We Who Fly Into Twilight') + E0 Boothill (Basic attacker feeding SP) vs a dummy Elite (atk 800 so a real ally is hurt between Hyacine's turns, Wind+Physical weakness, 600 Toughness), 3 cycles. Rotation: Ult summons Little Ica and enters After Rain 3 turns -> Skill 'Love Over the Rainbow' heals the ally the Elite hurt and auto-casts Rainclouds (After Rain) -> Little Ica's event-driven Take Sky fires at ally turn start / action end, consuming 4% own MaxHP -> a quiet turn (no hurt ally) ends with a Basic 'When Breeze Kisses Cirrus', and Hyacine's 4th turn start decrements After Rain to 0 (state torn down).

requirements.claim: Basic ATK 'When Breeze Kisses Cirrus' (140901) is a single-target Wind hit scaled off Hyacine's Max HP (toughDmg 10).
Skill 'Love Over the Rainbow' (140902, tag Restore) is a heal-all, no-damage Skill: the kit logs 'Skill: heals all' and never rolls a hit for it.

Ultimate 'We Who Fly Into Twilight' (140903) summons Little Ica, heals all allies and enters After Rain for 3 turns (ult_turns = 3, canon desc: duration decreases by 1 at the start of Hyacine's every turn).

of.log: Hyacine Ultimate: summons Little Ica, heals all; After Rain 3 turns

requirements.claim: Both Skill and Ultimate summon the memosprite Little Ica (kind summon, id ica_<owner>, owned by Hyacine); summonIca logs the summon with her MaxHP = 0.5 x Hyacine MaxHP (talent param 0.5) and fires the memosprite-summon event (AGENTS §11).

Memosprite Talent 'Take Sky in Hand' (1140903) is event-driven, not an AV turn: it resolves at the start of any ally turn AND after any target acts (kit onAllyTurnStart / onAllyActionEnd, canon 1140903), consuming 4% of Little Ica's own MaxHP before healing.
Memosprite Skill 'Rainclouds, Time to Go!' is an AoE Wind follow-up hit owned by Little Ica, scaled off the accumulated healing tally (kit rainclouds, hitAoe type fua).
A0 / trace permanent buff Gloomy Grin (hy_cr) grants Hyacine +100% Crit Rate (kit onStart: critRate 1.0, turns Infinity).
While After Rain is active all allies gain MaxHP +30% plus 600 (140903 #3/#4, ult_a3 at rank 10 = 0.3); the hy_ar_base buff carries hpPct 0.3.
Soar, Unto the Sunlight: summoning Little Ica regenerates Hyacine's Energy - +15 on every summon (mem_skill2 = 15), plus +30 extra on the first summon (mem_skill2_a2 = 30).
Skill 'Love Over the Rainbow' costs 1 Skill Point (140902 bp_need 1; kit sim.spendSp(1)) and refunds 30 Energy (sp_base 30).
Inside the Ultimate the memosprite exists before the Ultimate's summary note: summonIca runs first (logs the summon), then heal/After Rain, then the 'Ultimate: summons Little Ica' note.
Rainclouds only casts after After Rain is active: the first 'Little Ica Rainclouds' note comes after the Ultimate that entered After Rain (kit gates skill-side rainclouds on rt.afterRain > 0).
Take Sky cannot resolve before Little Ica exists: the first 'Little Ica Take Sky' note follows the summon note.

After Rain lasts exactly 3 of Hyacine's turns and is torn down once: onTurnStart decrements rt.afterRain, logs 'After Rain ends' at 0 and removes hy_ar_base/hy_ar from every ally (canon 140903: duration decreases by 1 at the start of Hyacine's every turn).

Talent 'First Light Heals the World' stacks on Little Ica herself: every Hyacine/Ica heal (skill/ult/Take Sky) adds the dmgAll stack buff hy_dmg on Little Ica (talent_a2 per stack, talent_a4 max stacks, AGENTS §9 lifetime per buff duration).
At E0 the E1-only MaxHP buff 'Cradle the Candle of Night' (hy_ar, +50%) must never appear - it is gated on eidolon >= 1 in applyAfterRainHp.
